description: Bar Chart with Export Data Feature by Office Solution This tool allows users to export data from the chart in multiple formats, enabling users to export the underlying dataset at run time. Key Features: Users can export the underlying dataset of the chart in Excel/CSV format. Users can draw an additional Average line at each individual bar level or overall chart level. Users can compare if an individual KPI is increasing or decreasing in relation to another KPI. Business users can change X-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change Y-Axis dimensions/Measures dynamically at run time. Business users can change X Legends dynamically at run time. Business users can focus only on the top 5 or top 10 areas. Users can add an additional KPI represented as icons at the end of bars with conditional formatting applied, helping assess whether key KPI indicators are performing well.
